i.norm: Verifies that {@link JsonIgnoreProperties.Value#mergeAll} combines several {@code Value} entries (skipping the null array slots) by OR-ing their boolean flags together, and that the merged result is a distinct instance from its inputs.
A Value with every boolean flag enabled (ignoreUnknown, allowGetters, allowSetters, merge) and no ignored property names.
A Value built from a property-name array; the resulting Value keeps the default flags (no ignoreUnknown, no allowGetters/Setters) but does enable merge.
mergeAll ignores the null slots and merges the two Values it finds.
The flags from allFlagsEnabled are OR-ed into the merged result.
The merge also carries over the ignored property name, so the result is neither equal to nor the same instance as the all-flags input.
